name: WenetSpeech-Wu-ASR-Bench
description: An ASR benchmark derived from the WenetSpeech collection focused on the Wu (Shanghainese / Wu dialect) subset, measuring automatic speech recognition performance on Wu speech data. It evaluates transcription quality across varied speakers and acoustic conditions representative of the dialect. The suite is intended to benchmark ASR systems' robustness to dialectal and regional Chinese varieties.
reputation: Part of the WenetSpeech ecosystem and used by the Chinese ASR community; adoption is growing for dialect-specific evaluation but smaller than mainstream Mandarin benchmarks.
